name: 王儀雯
objective:
本課程內容包括熱量傳送操作及其應用。
This course contents heat transfer and its application.
schedule:
Week#1: Overall Introduction
Week#2: Introduction to conduction
Week#3: One-Dimensional, Steady-State Conduction
Week#4: One-Dimensional, Steady-State Conduction
Week#5: Quiz 
Week#6: Two-Dimensional, Steady-State Conduction
Week#7: Introduction to Convection
Week#8: External Flow and Internal Flow
Week#9: Mid-term exam
Week#10: Boiling and Condensation
Week#11: Heat Exchangers
Week#12: Diffusion Mass Transfer
Week#13: Diffusion Mass Transfer 
Week#14: Individual Oral Presentation
Week#15: Individual Oral Presentation
Week#16: Final-term exam
scorePolicy:
Attendance: 10%
Quiz: 15%
Mid-term exams: 30%
Individual Oral Presentation: 15%
Final-term exams: 30%
Attendance checked about 8 times; up to 2 excused absences allowed.
materials: Frank P. Incropera et al., Incropera's Principles of Heat and Mass Transfer, WILEY.
延伸教學與資源: ● 混成學習 (Blended Learning) 課程結合實體授課與線上學習（同步視訊／非同步活動）。Combines face-to-face instruction with online learning (including synchronous video sessions or asynchronous activities).
課程對應SDGs指標: SDG4：優質教育（Quality Education）SDG7：可負擔的潔淨能源（Affordable and Clean Energy）SDG8：尊嚴就業與經濟發展（Decent Work and Economic Growth）SDG9：產業創新與基礎設施（Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure）
